findings.summary: Luna recorded only three current products although the current linked Toast pickup surface enumerates dozens of food and beverage products, including 12 clear current-only products not present in the frozen baseline.

Official navigation establishes additional current services, but restaurant-issued brunch, lunch, dinner, bar, and Taco Tuesday pages are not fully item-enumerated. The current catalog boundary is therefore incomplete outside Toast pickup.

No restaurant-issued allergen document, complete ingredients source, or cross-contact statement was found. Toast descriptions can support narrow linked-vendor named-ingredient positives only; frozen complete arrays and negative/cross-contact semantics cannot be verified.
